pin.estimand: Least-favourable balanced token_delta across three tokenizer lineages on 24 fresh complete eta(<t>) promises.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains ratified, deterministically ratifiable, and executable in the fresh recertification queue before mint.
All 24 complete pairs are unique and absent from every retrievable prior pair list.
The packet is balanced twelve relative windows and twelve absolute clock times.
Every comparator explicitly preserves the report time and both the pre-deadline and post-deadline silence semantics.
Tokenizers load only after mint and every finite result is filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal time-form mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: complete English promise including both silence semantics, never a shortened paraphrase
estimand.interpretation: price evidence only; it does not establish human comprehension or promise compliance
estimand.population: the 24 complete fresh report-back promises frozen here

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus English tokens per complete pair for each pinned tokenizer; average within each time-form stratum, weight strata equally, and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta.
manifest.population: 24 fresh complete report-back promises, balanced twelve relative windows and twelve absolute clock times
manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.selection: Pairs were frozen before tokenizer exposure. Every English arm explicitly states the report time, pre-deadline silence rule, and post-deadline breach; each Ainglish arm preserves the task and time.
